approved_by: Omri, 2026-09-24: use the tail_label_share_v1 finding to set between-group weights
motivation: tail_label_share_v1: label-driven share of inter-channel dependence 30.6% (argmax) / 21.8% (top20) vs 17.6% covariance on PRMBench; independent-channel quality recovery Spearman .77 (top20) vs .64 (covariance). named_group_fusion_v1: covariance L-SML gives the level groups ~80% of weight and plain averaging wins. Exploratory: the tail did not pass its own pre-declared 2x rule.
access: LABEL-USING DEVELOPMENT: PRMBench labels chose orientation (AUC sign), the AUC>=0.60 filter and the error-correlation grouping (error_cluster_lsml_v1 run_20260924, v2 orientation). All SML/L-SML weights are fitted label-free on fit folds. ProcessBench not used in design.

between_group.cov_sml: sml_fuse_signed on the M continuous group features (= named_group_fusion_v1 mean_sml)
between_group.tail20_sml / tail1_sml: per answer, indicator that a step is in a group feature's top k=max(1,ceil(0.2n)) (or k=1) steps, centred within answer; SML weights = sml_fuse_signed on those indicator columns over fit-fold rows; weights applied to the CONTINUOUS group features; oriented by Spearman with the group containing q15_H1
between_group.tail20_lsml / tail1_lsml: continuous L-SML fitted on the same indicator columns; weights applied to the continuous group features

folds_and_endpoints: as core_virtual_lsml_v1: fit three folds, calibrate (k+1)%5, evaluate k; PRMBench within-AUC + PRMScore; ProcessBench macro8 first-error accuracy; paired source-group bootstrap 20000
